source.title: Dromore Weekly Times and West Down Herald, 21 September 1946, p. 5 ("Rural councils: Banbridge and Hillsborough")
source.publisher: Dromore Weekly Times and West Down Herald (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Hillsborough votes from the Belfast Telegraph (4 October 1946, p. 7); unopposed names from the Dromore Weekly Times (21 September 1946, p. 5).

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. The only poll was in Hillsborough division (Belfast News-Letter, 4 October 1946, p. 3); Breda, where two were nominated, was therefore not polled and S. D. Stewart sat for it as a new member from the first meeting; thirteen other divisions were unopposed, and Ballymacbrennan and Carryduff had no nominations, so no member was elected for them (the council co-opted J. A. M'Kinstry, W. S. Patterson and G. C. Bell on 8 October 1946; co-options are not elections) (meetings pass, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
